BiblicalUsage: Yak is listed in the lexicon as a word for a hand or a side, but it has no occurrence anywhere in the Hebrew text I checked. The lemma never stands in a verse, so there is no passage to cite and no usage to trace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe it is better to say plainly that a word is not found than to invent a place for it in Scripture.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
